verses.en: They sacrificed sacrifices to the LORD and offered burnt offerings to the LORD on the next day after that day, even one thousand bulls, one thousand rams, and one thousand lambs, with their drink offerings and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel,
verses.zh: 次日，他们向耶和华献平安祭和燔祭，就是献公牛一千只，公绵羊一千只，羊羔一千只，并同献的奠祭；又为以色列众人献许多的祭。那日，他们在耶和华面前吃喝，大大欢乐。

verses.en: and ate and drank before the LORD on that day with great gladness. They made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him before the LORD to be prince, and Zadok to be priest.
verses.zh: 他们奉耶和华的命再膏大卫的儿子所罗门作王，又膏撒督作祭司。

words.g: and + to rub with oil, i.e. to anoint
and + to + Tsadok, the name of eight or nine Israelites

verses.en: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.
verses.zh: 于是所罗门坐在耶和华所赐的位上，接续他父亲大卫作王，万事亨通；以色列众人也都听从他。

words.g: father, in a literal and immediate + +him/his/it
and + to push forward, in various senses

verses.en: All the princes, the mighty men, and also all of the sons of King David submitted themselves to Solomon the king.
verses.zh: 众首领和勇士，并大卫王的众子，都顺服所罗门王。

verses.en: The LORD magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and gave to him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.
verses.zh: 耶和华使所罗门在以色列众人眼前甚为尊大，极其威严，胜过在他以前的以色列王。

words.g: to + the upper part, used only adverbially with prefix upward

verses.en: Now David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.
verses.zh: 耶西的儿子大卫作以色列众人的王，

verses.en: The time that he reigned over Israel was forty years; he reigned seven years in Hebron, and he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.
verses.zh: 作王共四十年：在希伯仑作王七年，在耶路撒冷作王三十三年。

words.g: in + Chebron, a place in Palestine
and + in + Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine

verses.en: He died at a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor; and Solomon his son reigned in his place.
verses.zh: 他年纪老迈，日子满足，享受丰富、尊荣，就死了。他儿子所罗门接续他作王。

words.g: and + weight, but only figuratively in a good sense

verses.en: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the history of Samuel the seer, and in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the history of Gad the seer,
verses.zh: 大卫王始终的事都写在先见撒母耳的书上和先知拿单并先见迦得的书上。

words.g: Shemuel, the name of three Israelites
Nathan, the name of five Israelites
the + a prophet or  inspired man

verses.en: with all his reign and his might, and the events that involved him, Israel, and all the kingdoms of the lands.
verses.zh: 他的国事和他的勇力，以及他和以色列并列国所经过的事都写在这书上。

words.g: dominion, i.e.  the estate  or  the country
